scenarios.title: Climb clearance
scenarios.situation: INDAIR 809 is maintaining FL160. Instruct commencement of climb to FL180. No SID restriction, conditional timing, or climb-rate instruction applies.
acceptable_examples: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE EIGHT ZERO.

incorrect_examples.text: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE NINE ZERO.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, MAINTAIN FLIGHT LEVEL ONE EIGHT ZERO.
incorrect_examples.reason: MAINTAIN does not substitute for CLIMB for a level change.

permitted_variation_notes: WHEN READY changes the requested timing and is not interchangeable here.
scenarios.assessment_scope: Assess full callsign, climb terminology, flight-level designation, and target 180. Broader operational procedure is not assessed.

scenarios.title: Left turn to heading 080
scenarios.situation: Under ATS surveillance control, INDAIR 809 is flying heading 120. Instruct a left turn to heading 080 for spacing.
acceptable_examples: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TURN LEFT HEADING ZERO EIGHT ZERO.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TURN LEFT HEADING ZERO EIGHT ZERO FOR SPACING.

incorrect_examples.text: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TURN RIGHT HEADING ZERO EIGHT ZERO.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TURN LEFT HEADING EIGHTY.
incorrect_examples.reason: Grouped wording conflicts with the heading-080 example only when wording evidence is reliably retained.

permitted_variation_notes: FOR SPACING is permitted but not mandatory.
A transcript containing only 080 cannot establish how the digits were spoken.
scenarios.assessment_scope: Assess full callsign, turn terminology, left direction, heading value 080, and number wording only when recognition evidence supports it. Broader procedure is not assessed.

scenarios.title: Departure squawk assignment
scenarios.situation: Before departure, assign INDAIR 809 new transponder code 3425. This is not a reselection, confirmation, or IDENT request.
acceptable_examples: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, SQUAWK THREE FOUR TWO FIVE.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, FOR DEPARTURE SQUAWK THREE FOUR TWO FIVE.

incorrect_examples.text: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, SQUAWK THREE FOUR TWO SIX.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, CONFIRM SQUAWK THREE FOUR TWO FIVE.
incorrect_examples.reason: A confirmation request is not a setting instruction.

permitted_variation_notes: FOR DEPARTURE is permitted but not required.
scenarios.assessment_scope: Assess full callsign, setting instruction, and complete code 3425. Broader operational procedure is not assessed.

scenarios.title: Detailed taxi instruction
scenarios.situation: At a fictional aerodrome, INDAIR 809 is at Stand 3. ATIS is available. Instruct taxi via taxiway A to holding point 1 for runway 27, explicitly holding short of runway 27. No intervening runway crossing exists.
scenarios.required_action: Issue the detailed taxi and hold-short instruction.
acceptable_examples: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TAXI TO HOLDING POINT ONE RUNWAY TWO SEVEN VIA ALFA, HOLD SHORT OF RUNWAY TWO SEVEN.

incorrect_examples.text: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TAXI TO HOLDING POINT ONE RUNWAY TWO SEVEN VIA BRAVO, HOLD SHORT OF RUNWAY TWO SEVEN.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, TAXI TO HOLDING POINT ONE RUNWAY TWO SEVEN VIA ALFA, CROSS RUNWAY TWO SEVEN.

permitted_variation_notes: ALPHA transcript spelling is equivalent to ALFA without acoustic scoring.
The explicit hold-short restriction is exercise-specific, not a universal claim for every taxi instruction.
scenarios.assessment_scope: Assess detailed taxi content and the exercise-specific hold-short boundary; do not assess fictional aerodrome feasibility.

scenarios.title: Incorrect level readback
scenarios.situation: The pilot has read back FL280 after a clearance to FL180. Correct the discrepancy without adopting FL280.
scenarios.required_action: Address the aircraft and correct the readback to FL180.
scenarios.previous_clearance: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE EIGHT ZERO.
scenarios.pilot_readback: CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL TWO EIGHT ZERO, INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE.
acceptable_examples: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, NEGATIVE, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE EIGHT ZERO.
INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, NEGATIVE, I SAY AGAIN, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL ONE EIGHT ZERO.

incorrect_examples.reason: Confirms the erroneous readback and omits the correct level.

incorrect_examples.text: INDAIR EIGHT ZERO NINE, NEGATIVE, CLIMB TO FLIGHT LEVEL TWO EIGHT ZERO.

permitted_variation_notes: Do not require the exact sample sentence or make NEGATIVE/CORRECTION universally mandatory.
NEGATIVE alone is insufficient because the correct clearance remains unstated.
Applicability of 12.8.7-12.8.8 to pilot-readback correction remains uncertain.
scenarios.assessment_scope: Assess addressing the aircraft, correction rather than confirmation, restating FL180, and avoiding adoption of FL280.
